A row nested directly inside a cell keeps its visible text

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<table><tr><td><tr><td>Visible text</td></tr></td></tr></table>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
